import os, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,16
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,I,requires_grad=True)
    ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); ref.weight.data=W.clone(); ref.bias.data.zero_()
    x2=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
    y=ref(x2); y.sum().backward()
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        m=cls(I,O,True,W); xx=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        out=m(xx); out.sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(out,y,atol=1e-5), cls
        assert torch.allclose(xx.grad,x2.grad,atol=1e-5), cls
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            c=O//ws; s=slice(rank*c,(rank+1)*c)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[s]); assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad[s])
        else:
            c=I//ws; s=slice(rank*c,(rank+1)*c)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[:,s]); assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad)
    if rank==0: print('ok', ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for i,ws in enumerate([1,2,4]): mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws)
